title: Recoupment of Paid Lines — Urological Supply Program Posting Rule
content:
In the Urological Supply Program a recoupment is recorded against the one paid line it takes back, as the original line; a paid line is reversed at most once. The reversed line no longer counts toward the item's covered-through date, and every patient charge stemming from it is removed under the rules of Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility.

## What a reversal record carries

The coverage that recouped, the one original line taken back, why it was taken back (audit recoupment, duplicate payment or coverage retro-termination), the amount taken back, the date of service of the reversed line, the recoupment remittance date and the claim control number of the reversal.

## Once per paid line

The evidence is the shipment record: reversal lines and the original line each one names.

| Reversals already recorded against the paid line | Effect |
|---|---|
| none | the recoupment is recorded against it |
| one | no second reversal of that line |

## Effect on the reversed line

- The reversed line no longer counts toward the item's covered-through date on the enrollment.
- Every patient charge stemming from the reversed line is removed under the rules of Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility.
